title: Evolutionary conservation of the structure and function of meiotic Rec114-Mei4 and Mer2 complexes.
authors: Daccache, Dima; De Jonge, Emma; Liloku, Pascaline; Mechleb, Karen; Haddad, Marita; Corthaut, Sam; Sterckx, Yann G-J; Volkov, Alexander N; Claeys Bouuaert, Corentin
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold建模结合NMR/SAXS研究减数分裂特异蛋白复合物与DNA的多价互作及凝聚机制，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-DNA互作建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Meiosis-specific Rec114-Mei4 and Mer2 complexes are thought to enable Spo11-mediated DNA double-strand break (DSB) formation through a mechanism that involves DNA-dependent condensation. However, the structure, molecular properties, and evolutionary conservation of Rec114-Mei4 and Mer2 are unclear. Here, we present AlphaFold models of Rec114-Mei4 and Mer2 complexes supported by nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS), and mutagenesis. We show that dimers composed of the Rec114 C terminus form alpha-helical chains that cup an N-terminal Mei4 alpha helix, and that Mer2 forms a parallel homotetrameric coiled coil. Both Rec114-Mei4 and Mer2 bind preferentially to branched DNA substrates, indicative of multivalent protein-DNA interactions. Indeed, the Rec114-Mei4 interaction domain contains two DNA-binding sites that point in opposite directions and drive condensation. The Mer2 coiled-coil domain bridges coaligned DNA duplexes, likely through extensive electrostatic interactions along the length of the coiled coil. Finally, we show that the structures of Rec114-Mei4 and Mer2 are conserved across eukaryotes, while DNA-binding properties vary significantly. This work provides insights into the mechanism whereby Rec114-Mei4 and Mer2 complexes promote the assembly of the meiotic DSB machinery and suggests a model in which Mer2 condensation is the essential driver of assembly, with the DNA-binding activity of Rec114-Mei4 playing a supportive role.
abstract_zh: 减数分裂特异的Rec114-Mei4和Mer2复合物被认为通过涉及DNA依赖性凝聚的机制，促成Spo11介导的DNA双链断裂（DSB）形成。然而，Rec114-Mei4和Mer2的结构、分子特性及进化保守性尚不清楚。在此，我们展示了由核磁共振（NMR）波谱、小角X射线散射（SAXS）和诱变支持Rec114-Mei4和Mer2复合物的AlphaFold模型。我们表明，由Rec114 C末端组成的二聚体形成α-螺旋链，包裹N端Mei4的α-螺旋，而Mer2形成平行的同源四聚体卷曲螺旋。Rec114-Mei4和Mer2均优先结合分支DNA底物，表明存在多价蛋白质-DNA相互作用。确实，Rec114-Mei4相互作用域包含两个指向相反方向并驱动凝聚的DNA结合位点。Mer2卷曲螺旋域桥接对齐的DNA双链体，可能通过沿卷曲螺旋长度的广泛静电相互作用实现。最后，我们表明Rec114-Mei4和Mer2的结构在真核生物中保守，而DNA结合特性则显著变化。这项工作提供了对Rec114-Mei4和Mer2复合物促进减数分裂DSB机制组装的见解，并提出一个模型，其中Mer2凝聚是组装的关键驱动因素，而Rec114-Mei4的DNA结合活性起支持作用。
